title: Bhaiya teri maa jayi ne yeh bhi dekha shaam ke
body:
1.Bhaiya teri maa jayi ne yeh bhi dekha shaam ke baad
shaam se pehle khatl huwa tu paani aaya shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
2. din ke ujaale mein laila ne hashr ke manzar dekhliye
noke sinha per dekh rahi hai chand ka tukda shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
3. qasim-o-akber aun-o-mohammed khana-e-zehra ke the chiraag
soone ghar me yaad ayega har shahzada shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
4. baba ko jab yaad karegi shimr tamache maarega
ho jayenge khoon mein tar ruksaar-e- sakina shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
5. jalte khaime hashr ka manzar haye sitam abbas nahi
dhoond rahi hai zainab-e-muztar qaima qaima shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
6. asghar maqtal jaate jaate khushbu apni chod gaye
maa ankhon se choom rahi hai khaali jhoola shaam ke baad
